go:air-squat.text: Air squats. Feet shoulder width, sit back and down, chest up.

go:backpack-row.text: Backpack rows. Fill a backpack or shopping bag.

go:bear-crawl.text: Bear crawl. Hands and feet, knees just off the ground.

go:bent-over-row.text: Bent over rows. Hinge to 45 degrees, flat back, row both dumbbells to the ribs.

go:bike.text: Bike. Smooth cadence, light grip, breathe through the nose when you can.

go:bike-sprint.text: Bike sprint. All-out cadence, then hold it.

go:bird-dog.text: Bird dogs. On hands and knees, reach the opposite arm and leg long.

go:burpee.text: Burpees. Hands down, jump or step back to a plank, back up and jump.

go:bw-lunge.text: Lunges. Step back, lower the back knee toward the floor, alternate legs.

go:cardio-choice.text: Cardio, your choice. Pick any machine and hold a strong, steady pace.

go:cd-chest.text: Chest opener. Hands clasped behind you, lift the chest, shoulders down.

go:cd-hamstring.text: Hamstring fold. Soft knees, hang forward, let the head relax.

go:cd-hip-flexor.text: Hip flexor stretch. Half kneeling, squeeze the glute, lean forward gently.

go:cd-walk.text: Cool down. Easy walk. Bring the heart rate down.

go:clean-thruster.text: Clean and thruster. Clean to the rack, front squat, drive straight into the press.

go:core-finish.text: Knee drives or dead bugs. Standing knee drives or dead bugs on the floor.

go:db-clean.text: Dumbbell cleans. Pull from the hip, catch at the shoulder with soft knees.

go:db-floor-press.text: Floor press. Lie on the floor, elbows at 45 degrees, press to lockout.

go:db-rdl.text: Romanian deadlifts. Soft knees, push the hips back, weights close to the legs.

go:db-row.text: Dumbbell rows. Support on a bench or knee.

go:db-ski-punch.text: Dumbbell ski punches. Light dumbbells, fast downward ski pulls into punches.

go:db-squat.text: Dumbbell squats. Dumbbells at your sides or shoulders.

go:db-swing.text: Dumbbell swings. Hold one dumbbell by the head.

go:db-thruster.text: Dumbbell thrusters. Squat with the dumbbells at your shoulders, drive up into a press.

go:deadlift-front-rack.text: Deadlift to front rack. Deadlift, pause, then guide the bell into the rack.

go:farmer-carry.text: Farmer carry. Heavy weights at your sides.

go:farmer-march.text: Farmer march. Heavy weights at your sides, march in place, knees high.

go:front-rack-carry.text: Front rack carry. Weights at the shoulders, elbows up, ribs down.

go:glute-bridge.text: Glute bridges. On your back, feet flat.

go:goblet-squat.text: Goblet squats. One heavy weight at the chest.

go:high-knee-march.text: High knee march. Drive knees to hip height, pump the arms hard.

go:high-knees.text: High knees. Run in place, knees to hip height, quick arms.

go:high-pull.text: High pulls. Drive the hips, pull the elbow high and back.

go:hinge-jump.text: Hip hinge jumps. Hinge back with a flat back, swing the arms, jump tall.

go:incline-walk.text: Incline walk. Steep incline, brisk pace, hands off the rails.

go:jog-in-place.text: Jog in place. Light, quick steps on the balls of your feet.

go:jump-rope.text: Jump rope. Small jumps on the balls of the feet, turn the rope from the wrists.

go:jumping-jacks.text: Jumping jacks. Light and quick on the balls of the feet.

go:kb-clean.text: Kettlebell cleans. Keep the bell close, let it roll around the wrist into the rack.

go:kb-deadlift.text: Kettlebell deadlifts. Bell between the feet, flat back, stand tall.

go:kb-front-squat.text: Front squats. Bell in the rack, elbow tucked, sit between the hips.

go:kb-push-press.text: Push press. Small dip, drive with the legs, lock out overhead.

go:kb-reverse-lunge.text: Reverse lunges. Bell in the rack or at your side.

go:kb-row.text: One arm rows. Hinge, flat back, pull the bell to the hip.

go:kb-suitcase-carry.text: Suitcase carry. One bell at your side.

go:kb-swing.text: Kettlebell swings. Hinge, hike the bell back, snap the hips.

go:kb-swing-fast.text: Fast kettlebell swings. Snap the hips, quick tempo, bell to chest height.

go:knee-push-up.text: Knee push ups. Knees down, hips in line with the shoulders.

go:march-in-place.text: March in place. Lift the knees to hip height and swing the arms.

go:mountain-climbers.text: Mountain climbers. High plank, drive the knees to the chest one at a time.

go:overhead-carry.text: Overhead carry. Lock the weight overhead, biceps by the ear.

go:pike-push-up.text: Pike push ups. Hips high, lower the head toward the floor between the hands, press back up.

go:plank-shoulder-taps.text: Plank shoulder taps. High plank, feet wide.

go:prone-ytw.text: Y T W raises. Face down.

go:push-press.text: Push press. Small dip, drive with the legs, lock out overhead.

go:push-up.text: Push ups. Hands under the shoulders, body in one line.

go:rapid-step-ups.text: Rapid step ups. Low box, quick alternating steps.

go:reverse-lunge.text: Reverse lunges. Step back, lower the back knee toward the floor, alternate legs.

go:row.text: Row. Legs, then hips, then arms.

go:run-outside.text: Run. Outside on a flat route.

go:shadow-boxing.text: Shadow boxing. Fast combinations, stay light on your feet.

go:shoulder-press.text: Shoulder press. Brace, ribs down, press straight overhead.

go:side-plank.text: Side plank. Elbow under the shoulder, hips high.

go:single-leg-rdl.text: Single leg R D Ls. Reach down as one leg lifts behind you, hips square.

go:sit-to-stand.text: Sit to stand. Sit on a chair, stand up without using your hands.

go:skater-jumps.text: Skater jumps. Leap side to side, land on one leg with a soft knee.

go:split-squat.text: Split squats. One foot forward, one back.

go:squat-press.text: Squat and press. Full squat, stand, then press.

go:squat-thrust.text: Step back burpees. Hands down, step back to a plank one foot at a time, step in, stand.

go:squat-to-press.text: Squat to press. Squat with dumbbells at the shoulders, stand and press in one motion.

go:suitcase-carry.text: Suitcase carry. One heavy weight at your side.

go:suitcase-left.text: Suitcase carry, left hand. Weight in the left hand.

go:suitcase-right.text: Suitcase carry, right hand. Weight in the right hand.

go:walk-outside.text: Brisk walk. Walk with purpose, arms swinging.

go:wall-push-up.text: Wall push ups. Hands on a wall, body straight.

go:wall-sit.text: Wall sit. Back flat on a wall, thighs level with the floor.

go:wu-arm-circles.text: Arm circles. Big slow circles forward, then backward.

go:wu-hinge.text: Hip hinges. Hands on hips, push the hips back with a flat back.

go:wu-inchworm.text: Inchworms. Walk the hands out to a plank, walk them back.

go:wu-lunge-reach.text: Lunge and reach. Step back, reach both arms overhead, alternate legs.

go:wu-march.text: Warm up. Easy march. Get the blood moving.
